chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Willie Bryant's band and his dancing partner
summary: Willie Bryant, an entertainer rather than a musician, led a band with Carter, Webster and Teddy Wilson; Jackson first saw him with the Whitman Sisters' show.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit

blocks.x: That's right. Cozy Cole, he went there -- You know, Cozy Cole played with Willie Bryant's band used to be in the Savoy.

Bennie Carter was in that band. Ben Webster was in that band. Teddy Wilson was in that band Willie Bryant had at one time, you know. And Willie Bryant was an entertainer. He wasn't a musician but he liked musicians.
That's right, he was a dancer. He used to dance. He had a dance act at first.
Oh, yes, him and Leonard Reed.
They was with Toby's show years ago called the Whitman Sisters.
